prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished native Android phone screen at portrait viewport 412x915 logical pixels, edge-to-edge flat app screenshot, no phone frame, desk, poster, or browser. Product AnVề, Vietnamese family location sharing. This is a diagnostic detail screen reached from the existing tracking screen; top app bar has Back, title “Chẩn đoán vị trí”, refresh icon. Android system bars present; no bottom navigation on this nested detail screen. Match the attached splash reference ONLY for AnVề's existing teal brand; do NOT reproduce splash content or gradient. Existing Material 3 brand is deep teal #00505A, pale sand #FBF7F0, dark ink #11201F, amber #D98E32 reserved for limitations, Roboto. Preserve native Material affordances and generous readable Vietnamese text, careful alignment, 48dp touch areas. Signature: distinguish acquisition from delivery so offline is not mistaken for tracking stopped.
Use the same illustrative diagnostic scenario: “Đang ghi, chờ có mạng”; “Mất kết nối mạng”; “Vị trí vẫn được lưu trên máy. Khi có mạng, AnVề sẽ thử gửi lại.” Network-settings action “Mở cài đặt mạng”. Facts: location permission “Chính xác”; background permission “Đã cấp”; location service “Đã bật”; tracking service “Đang chạy”; battery saver “Đang bật”; “12 điểm chờ gửi”; “Lần ghi gần nhất · 1 phút trước”; “Lần gửi thành công · 8 phút trước”. No map, coordinates, personal identities, confidence percentage, battery percentage claims, or invented performance chart. End with low-emphasis “Xuất báo cáo” and “Không chứa tọa độ hay thông tin đăng nhập”; additional technical detail can be below the fold. Include a small preview label “Dữ liệu minh họa”. Composition C, grouped overview: below app bar a concise status headline; then two equal native segmented tabs “Tổng quan” selected and “Chi tiết”. Under a slim offline notice with the settings action, group facts into three clearly separated sections “Thu thập vị trí”, “Đồng bộ”, “Quyền & thiết bị”. Acquisition times and running service lead; queue and upload time next; permissions and battery last. Use structured rows and restrained tonal section headings, not a grid of metric tiles. Focal point is a clean overview with technical information available on demand.
purpose: M7-A diagnostics design comp; synthetic data; not runtime evidence
approval: User selected C: overview and details in this conversation.
